description: ADR-0009 / PLAN_EXTERNAL_AI_REVIEW_2026-07-26.md §3: the mission registry build-review-pack.py reads from. Each entry validates against NPDevContract/schemas/external-ai-mission.schema.json. paths is repo-relative; missions whose content is per-generated-app (M1, M6) or per-app-runtime (M7) deliberately leave paths empty -- supply --paths at build time.

missions.title: Calibration control -- pre-fix parent of LNCH13-F1 (CRITICAL)
missions.description: Row-level write authorization bypass on flow-backed CRUD: a concept declaring a custom create/update/delete flow got ZERO row-level access.write enforcement on its generated REST endpoint. Fixed at commit 22fb5c8. sourceCommit below is that fix's direct parent (git rev-parse 22fb5c8^), i.e. the code exactly as it stood before the fix -- confirmed against this repo's real history on 2026-07-26, not invented.
packContents: service-base.mustache at the pre-fix parent of 22fb5c8 (LNCH13-F1)
excluded: the fix commit and its message

missions.title: Calibration control -- pre-fix parent of R3-F2 (HIGH)
missions.description: Every many-to-many bond in every generated app exposed four HTTP endpoints with zero authorization. Fixed at commit 75c1b40. sourceCommit below is that fix's direct parent (git rev-parse 75c1b40^) -- confirmed against this repo's real history on 2026-07-26.
packContents: service-base.mustache (m2m bond endpoints) at the pre-fix parent of 75c1b40 (R3-F2)
excluded: the fix commit and its message

missions.title: Adversarial review -- a generated app's emitted Java
missions.description: 2-3 concepts' emitted Java incl. one with custom flows (~5-8k lines sliced from ~75k). Emitted code is per-generated-app under D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\Build (outside this repo, per the Build Output Location Policy) -- there is no static in-repo path, so this mission has none configured. Supply --paths pointing at the generated app's source when actually building this pack.
packContents: 2-3 concepts' emitted Java incl. one with custom flows

missions.title: Adversarial review -- row-level authorization
missions.description: DefaultConceptGateway, ConceptGateway, the semantic policy, and ACCEPTED_BOUNDARIES.md, at the working tree unless --commit overrides it.

missions.title: Adversarial review -- tenant isolation
missions.description: ExecutionContext, TenantIsolationPolicy, and the persistence-postgres adapter's SQL, at the working tree unless --commit overrides it.

missions.title: Blind reproduction -- clone/build/run
missions.description: GETTING_STARTED.md text only; the AI emits a command plan, a clean Linux container / GH runner executes it -- never this session.

missions.title: Cold-start authoring test
missions.description: TUTORIAL_FIRST_APP.md + DSL_REFERENCE.md only; the AI authors a model.json blind, we build and relay errors verbatim.
excluded: everything else, per the cold-start kit's own rule

missions.title: Independent audit verdict
missions.description: An evidence bundle + explicit claim list, supplied per run via --paths -- there is no fixed set.

missions.title: Impact-report MANUAL_REVIEW convertibility judgment
missions.description: An Impact Report's MANUAL_REVIEW item + the column's shape/sample distribution (values redacted). Per-app product feature (P6/P7): built by com.finalexec.review inside a generated app against that app's own data. This platform producer (scripts/external-review/) does not build this pack; the entry exists so the mission registry is complete and the P8 gate can account for all 9 missions.
excluded: other Impact Report items not under review
